bullets: Architected 'Profit Sheet,' a centralized real-time financial dashboard aggregating live revenue, margins, and profit metrics seamlessly across Amazon, Flipkart, Shopify, Meesho, Tata 1mg, and internal telesales.
Engineered a comprehensive Order Management System (OMS) akin to Unicommerce, centralizing multi-channel order processing, real-time inventory synchronization, and automated fulfillment tracking.
Developed a full-stack CRM tailored for a high-performing telesales team, delivering advanced data filtering, real-time analytics, and lead tracking to boost conversion rates.
Built robust backend REST APIs using Node.js and Prisma, ensuring highly reliable data management and seamless integration with multiple third-party e-commerce webhooks.

Containerized PostgreSQL and Redis databases using Docker, maintaining strict data consistency, and configured production infrastructure on AWS EC2 utilizing Nginx and PM2 for zero-downtime deployments.

Engineered high-performance cross-platform mobile interfaces for ThinQ Media, a large-scale streaming application, utilizing React Native to deliver seamless viewing experiences for over 1M+ iOS and Android users.

Developed core distribution and file management workflows for AppsOnAir, an OTA platform serving 50,000+ developers, heavily optimizing the upload, parsing, and deployment processes for APK and IPA files.

Built and scaled secure frontend architectures for ContactBook, a multi-tenant SaaS platform used by 5,000+ professionals, implementing complex subscription-based workspace sharing and role-based access controls.
Delivered Samachar, a personalized regional news aggregation app, integrating dynamic category routing, push notifications, and responsive UI components to drive localized user engagement.
Collaborated in a fast-paced Agile environment, working closely with backend engineers and product teams to integrate RESTful APIs and consistently meet aggressive release deadlines.
Architected and deployed full-stack MERN and Next.js web applications, successfully configuring and securing scalable hosting environments on AWS Windows servers.
Engineered a dynamic, high-performance admin dashboard using Next.js, leveraging server-side rendering (SSR) to streamline internal workflows and simplify backend data management.
Led the frontend execution of a comprehensive dual B2B & B2C e-commerce platform, integrating secure payment gateways and optimizing user checkout journeys.
Implemented rigorous API integrations and state management solutions using Redux and React Query, ensuring data consistency across complex, multi-step user flows.
Accelerated the product delivery cycle by rapidly developing and deploying 6 cross-platform React Native mobile applications and a React web app within a tight 6-month timeframe.
Integrated robust PHP and MySQL backend architectures to support data-intensive mobile and web features, ensuring high availability and seamless data synchronization.
Executed aggressive performance optimizations, overhauling component rendering and API fetching strategies to drastically cut load times and boost cross-device responsiveness.
Bridged the gap between design and engineering, collaborating closely with UI/UX and product teams to translate complex Figma wireframes into polished, production-ready applications.
